log.msg: COLD WALK, 104 pages x 1280 and 3440 = 208 loads (I followed every in-realm link, so more urls than the 58 I counted at visit six). ONE console error at each width and it is the same known one: the declared-child probe 404 on readme/page.js. Zero sideways document scroll at either width. No visible zero-size box. Every page has an active page and 101 of the 104 titles are distinct.

MY INSTRUMENT FOUND ITSELF FIRST, THREE TIMES, BEFORE IT FOUND ANYTHING REAL. (a) My zero-size check flagged nearly every page until I filtered by checkVisibility - the boxes were inactive pages at display none or contents, correct by design. (b) My overflow check flagged every page until I read the class names: DIV.dev-bar is the dev servers own drawer parked past the right edge, not the realm. (c) My crawler appended a trailing slash to hrefs ending .md and .js and manufactured eight 404s that do not exist - clicked for real, /imagine/paging/made/page.json, doc/persistence.md and words.js all serve their file and none logs an error. None of the three was the realms fault. Only after fixing all three did the numbers above mean anything.

log.msg: ALL SIX OF MY VISIT-6 ITEMS ARE FIXED, RE-MEASURED. (1) The bar keeps its row: at 1280 NAVIGATION, CONTENT, ROOM and ARRANGEMENT are each 57px tall at top 220 with their labels on one baseline - CONTENT was 106 against its siblings 57 - and at 3440 all four are 67 at top 323. SKIN is 75px at 202 because it is a super-group holding three sub-controls, which the screenshot shows plainly; that is design, not a break. (2) The address has its own full-width line: .paging-address is 934px at top 328 (2790 at 3440), and the field is 582px at 1280 and 2370 at 3440 holding my 56-character address with scrollWidth == clientWidth - the whole value readable, where it showed 12 of 56. Draw it and Copy sit beside it, both tabindex 0 and role button. (3) The miss tells the truth: ?content=/framework/ui/ now says Nothing here could be read at /framework/ui/ and names the three addresses that work and why the rest are code. (4) An off-site address is kept in the url, shown in the field, noted at the field as Off-site - not read, and declared in the box. (5) Contents lede at y136 - above the fold - names the ninth answer in its first sentence; it was two folds down. (6) Builds file pane is 957 client on 957 scroll at 1280 and 2847 on 2847 at 3440, with a Copy; it was 287 on 455.

THE EIGHT-STEP USE TEST. What I wanted, written into my own note before I asked for it: a page with a rail on the left, reading width, in the dark, with that note in the box and a whole other page nested under it. (1) PICK - four dropdowns and the address field took it. (2) SEND - ?navigation=rail&content=%2Fframework%2Fai%2F2026-09-05%2Fpaging-audit-7%2Fnewcomer-note.md&room=reading&page-colour=dark. (3) COLD - a fresh browser gave identical classes, all eight values and my words in the box. (4) NEST - the drawers dashboard chip put a whole page inside mine and wrote nest=dashboard into the address. (5) SAVE - Make this a page wrote made/seventh-visit/page.json with mode.nest dashboard. (6) OPEN COLD - /imagine/paging/make/seventh-visit/ opens at 1280 and 3440 with ZERO console errors: two visible stages, mine at bg-dark room-full nav-rail holding my note, the nested dashboard wearing its own bg-tint type-compact arr-bar-top, and two h1s - Seventh visit and The seventh visit. (7) RE-SAVE - I set room Full from THAT pages own bar; the file read full within the second and the address stayed bare. (8) RELOAD BARE - it came back full, dark, rail, my note, nest intact. All eight worked.

THE ONE THING THAT BROKE, AND IT LOSES WORK SILENTLY. The drawers nest field takes a typed address, but only ENTER commits it - and nothing says so. I typed dashboard into the nest field, typed a name, pressed Make this a page, and got a green check_circle reading Saved to disk as public/imagine/paging/made/seventh-no-enter/page.json. The file has no nest key at all. Same with a url: I typed /imagine/paging/library/blog-post/ and the saved file was nest-less. Pressing Enter first puts nest=dashboard in the url and then the save carries it. So the realm confirms a save that dropped what I typed. The field right above it - the address in the box - has a visible Draw it button, so the bar has TAUGHT me that a field needs a button; the nest field has none. And the nest field never reads back: arrive at ?nest=dashboard and the chip is pressed but the field is empty.

MY INSTRUMENT FOUND ITSELF FIVE TIMES BEFORE IT FOUND THAT. Beyond the three in the walk: (d) I clicked a chip reading Dashboard and reported that the nest chip overwrote content= - it was the CONTENT chip of the same name, in the same drawer; the real nest chips are the icon-prefixed twelve. (e) I reported that typing in the nest field made the nest band appear - the band .paging-nest is the drawers own section heading and was there before I typed. Both would have been false findings. Two controls named Dashboard in one drawer is the only real residue of that, and it is small.
SIX WORDS, seventh visit (delta from 5/5/5/4/5/5). simple 5 -> 5. powerful 5 -> 5. organized 5 -> 5. intuitive 4 -> 4. easy to browse 5 -> 5. infinite potential 5 -> 5.

WHY INTUITIVE IS STILL 4, AND EXACTLY WHAT WOULD MAKE IT 5. All three reasons visit six gave are gone and measured gone. The one that holds it is new and it is worse in KIND than the three it replaced: those were ugly or wrongly worded, and this one takes my work and tells me it kept it. Type a nest, press the big Save button, read a green tick naming the file it wrote - and the nest is not in the file. Nothing on screen says Enter is the commit, and the field directly above it has a Draw it button, so the bar has already taught me the opposite rule. EXACTLY WHAT WOULD MAKE IT 5: give the nest field the visible commit its neighbour has, or read the fields live value when Save is pressed - either one, and the tick stops lying. That is the whole gap. The other four items on my list are labels and housekeeping.

MY EXIT CONDITION, ANSWERED. Of my five, FOUR ARE TRUE. (2) is true and it is the eighth step: I saved a nested configuration and opened it cold - my note, in the dark, at full width, with a whole dashboard running inside it, on a page that did not exist an hour ago. (3) one set of names, true. (4) nothing broken at either width - 104 pages x 1280 and 3440 = 208 cold loads, one console error and it is the known readme probe 404, zero sideways scroll. (5) infinite potential, true in both halves. WHAT IS NOT TRUE IS (1), every label delivers within one screen: Make this a page says it saved a nest it did not save, and on /templates/navigation/ a link whose text reads imagine/paging/words.js goes to doc/mechanisms.md.

WHAT A NEWCOMER STILL CANNOT DO. Unmake a page they made - there is no delete, remove or discard anywhere in the realm, so ten trial pages are ten permanent rail rows and the only way out is the filesystem (and deleting the directory by hand leaves the parents children naming a page that 404s, the exact trap CLAUDE.md warns about - I did it by accident and had to git checkout the parent). Add a child under the page they are looking at from its own bar. Type prose into the box without going to Build. Only the first is new this visit; none of them stopped me getting the page I came for.

FIX LIST, ranked. NOT cosmetic only - item 1 loses the readers work and says it did not. 1 The nest field says Saved and drops what you typed - the drawer, on any page - type a nest, press Make this a page without pressing Enter first, and a green check_circle names the file it wrote while the file has no nest key; Enter is the only commit and nothing says so, while the address field directly above has a visible Draw it button - give the nest field the same button, or read its live value at save time - S. 2 The nest field never reads back - the drawer, on any page reached by ?nest= - arrive at ?nest=dashboard and the chip is pressed but the field is empty, so the one control that can hold an arbitrary nest cannot show or edit the nest you arrived with - fill it from the url like the address field is - S. 3 A page you make can never be unmade - /imagine/paging/make/ and the drawer - there is no delete, remove or discard anywhere, so every trial page is a permanent rail row, and removing the directory by hand leaves the parents children naming a page that 404s - one Remove this page that edits both the dir and the parents children - M. 4 A link names one file and goes to another - /imagine/paging/templates/navigation/ - the anchor text reads imagine/paging/words.js - the four, said once and the href is /imagine/paging/doc/mechanisms.md - point it at words.js or rename the label - S. 5 Three docs are linked as raw markdown when a rendered page for the same doc exists - /templates/theming/ The proposal, and doc/persistence.md from /make/, /build/ and all four made pages - the raw file arrives as unstyled text with no title and no way back, while /imagine/paging/doc/templates/ and /doc/persistence/ render the same words inside the site - point the prose links at the rendered pages and keep the raw link only where the point IS the file - S.

assign.outcome:
**Seventh visit: 5 / 5 / 5 / 4 / 5 / 5 — unchanged. All six of my sixth-visit items are fixed and measured, the eight-step use test passed, and one new thing breaks in the worst way: a save that says it kept something it threw away.**

**Not "cosmetic only."** Four of my five exit conditions are true. The one that is not is the first — *every label delivers what it promises within one screen* — and it fails twice.

![My note, in the dark, at full width, with a whole dashboard running inside it, on a page that did not exist an hour ago](shots/my-note-nested-saved-1280.png)

**The eight-step use test, all eight worked.** I wrote what I wanted into my own note before I asked for it: *a page with a rail on the left, reading width, in the dark, with this note in the box and a whole other page nested under it.* Pick · send · open cold · nest · save · **open the saved page cold** · change it from its own bar · reload bare. The saved page carries `mode.nest`, opens at 1280 and 3440 with **zero console errors**, and holds two h1s — its own and my note's — with the nested dashboard wearing its own words.

**All six sixth-visit items are fixed, re-measured.** The bar keeps its row (`NAVIGATION` `CONTENT` `ROOM` `ARRANGEMENT` all **57px at top 220**; `CONTENT` was 106 against its siblings' 57). The address has its own full-width line and a **582px field at 1280, 2370px at 3440**, holding my 56-character address with nothing clipped — it showed 12 of 56. The miss tells the truth. An off-site address is declared, not dropped. Content's lede names the ninth answer **above the fold**. Build's file pane is **957 on 957**.

**208 cold loads** — 104 pages × 1280 and 3440, following every in-realm link — **one console error**, the known `readme/page.js` probe 404, and zero sideways scroll at either width.

![Type a nest, press Save, and the green tick names a file that does not contain it](shots/nest-dropped-1280.png)

**Why `intuitive` is still 4, and exactly what would make it 5.** All three reasons visit six gave are gone. The one that holds it is new and worse in kind: **type a nest into the drawer's field, press *Make this a page*, and a green tick names the file it wrote — while the file has no `nest` key.** Only Enter commits that field, and nothing says so, while the address field directly above it has a visible *Draw it* button that teaches the opposite rule. **Give the nest field the button its neighbour has, or read its live value when Save is pressed** — either one, and the tick stops lying. That is the whole gap.

**Five items, ranked in the log.** One loses work; the other four are labels and housekeeping.

**Left deliberately:** three things a newcomer still cannot do — unmake a page they made (there is no delete anywhere, so every trial page is a permanent rail row), add a child from the page's own bar, or type prose into the box outside Build. Only the first is new.

**My instrument found itself five times before it found anything real** — a zero-size check that flagged hidden pages, an overflow check that flagged the dev server's own drawer, a crawler that manufactured eight 404s by appending slashes to `.md` links, a chip click that hit a same-named control in the wrong group, and a "band appeared" that was always there. Every one would have been a false finding.

**Hygiene:** private server 8097, killed by pid; three test pages made and deleted; `made/` byte-identical to baseline by md5; `git status` shows only this task dir.
